title: Harness Engineering 2.0
dek: We asked what stops a loop from rewriting its own harness, graded old links by hand, then handed the grading to a second agent.
description: Notes from the Harness Engineering 2.0 masterclass, 22 November 2026: the verifier you write by hand, the first agent, the rounds of correction, and the second agent that takes them over. With the repo.
